title: Mood Music
identity: Camden CM061 Mood Music is a six-piece alto saxophone and piano collection credited in retailer catalogues to Philip or Phillip Gates; composer spelling remains unresolved across those listings. The National College of Music, London’s alto/baritone syllabus includes Wonderland, one title from the collection, on its Grade 5 solo list.

evidence.claim: Catalog lead lists CM061, six movements and classical/jazz bridge description; composer spelling Philip vs Phillip needs confirmation.

The National College of Music, London Grade Examinations in E-flat Alto/Baritone Saxophone lists Gates’s Wonderland from Mood Music under Grade 5 (Students’ Division). This supports that one item only; it does not establish a grade for all six pieces.
evidence.source_name: National College of Music, London saxophone syllabus

review_focus: Identify the correct composer and edition, then inspect the six contrasting miniatures and the saxophone/piano parts.
collection_flag: A current NCM London syllabus places Wonderland on its Grade 5 solo list. This is a source-specific placement for one item, not the whole collection or a SaxoBrain level.
